_note: Hand-authored scenes for the Godot vertical slice. Story text carried over from the web build.

stakes.text: 6:02 AM. Quiapo, in the rain. Candle vendors drag their tarps out and the church bells start.
On Renzo's bench, under the tweezers: a final notice from Asian Housing & Credit Corp. His phone buzzes with the same message.

stakes.speaker: R. Valdez (text)
stakes.text: Reyes. Honda Beat, P3,450, two months late. My tow truck will be on Carriedo at noon. Pay, or I take the bike. Asian Housing & Credit Corp.

stakes.speaker: Renzo
stakes.text: Noon. Six hours. Without the Honda there are no courier runs, and without runs there is no rent and no coil for the shop.
Six hours to find P3,450, keep a Honda running, and work out why his grandmother has started packing the shop into crates.

dante_call.text: Halfway there, Renzo's phone rings. An unknown number. He answers with one hand.

dante_call.speaker: Dante
dante_call.text: Don't hang up, kid. Is it ticking? Whatever your lola gave you, is it ticking?

dante_call.speaker: Renzo
dante_call.text: Who is this? How did you get this number?

dante_call.speaker: Dante
dante_call.text: A friend of hers. The seal she's been keeping is wearing thin, and the water is rising before its time. Things come up with floods. Stay on lit streets tonight.

dante_call.speaker: Renzo
dante_call.text: Lit streets. Right. The delivery is down the one alley in Quiapo with no working lamps.
The line goes dead. The bells ring the hour, a heartbeat late.

alley_arrival.text: Quiapo, dusk. The watch ticks against Renzo's palm, backward and patient: one last delivery, down the alley behind Evangelista Street.

alley_arrival.speaker: Renzo
alley_arrival.text: The invoice says Gat. Dizon, Bodega 9. The ink is too fresh and the signature is traced. A fake. Great.

alley_arrival.speaker: Renzo
alley_arrival.text: Lola has never let anyone else touch this watch, and tonight she's sending it to a stranger at the end of an alley. That is not easy money. That is a goodbye.
High above, on the rusted fire escape, one patch of iron has stopped getting rained on.
Rusted iron screams overhead. Something heavy lands in the dark.

alley_arrival.speaker: Renzo
alley_arrival.text: Diyos ko... the lamps, they all went out. And that thing... it was on the fire escape the whole time.

alley_arrival.speaker: Renzo
alley_arrival.text: All I've got is a balisong... Walang atrasan. Walang atrasan. Say it like you mean it, Renzo.

after_fight.text: The last of the smoke washes down the drain. Renzo's hands are shaking. The watch is burning against his ribs, hands spinning backward.
Headlights. An engine screaming straight down the alley.

after_fight.speaker: Dante
after_fight.text: RENZO! Get in the van! Lola's seal is broken. That thing isn't supposed to be out of the Veil!

after_fight.speaker: Dante
after_fight.text: ...Kid. I saw that. The rain fell upward for three seconds, and your pocket was glowing. You rewound something.

after_fight.speaker: Renzo
after_fight.text: It does that. It has been doing that all day.

after_fight.speaker: Dante
after_fight.text: No. It does not. Get in the van.

act1_hook.text: The Avenida is a brown river up to the Honda's footpegs. The only dry way to Bodega 9 is the alley behind Evangelista Street.

act1_hook.speaker: Renzo
act1_hook.text: No lamps. No witnesses. Dante said stay on lit streets. Dante is not the one with a noon deadline.
Renzo turns the Honda into the dark.
